queries.title: 🔎 Search Queries
queries.description: List of business types to find (e.g. ['dentist', 'pizza']).

locations.title: 📍 Locations (Text)
locations.description: List of locations to search in (e.g. ['Berlin', 'Hamburg']).

geo.title: 🗺️ Location (Lat/Lng)
geo.description: Search by coordinates and radius instead of text location.

maxResultsTotal.title: 📦 Max Results Total
maxResultsTotal.description: Maximum number of unique leads to output for the whole run.

includeClosed.title: 🏪 Include Closed Businesses
includeClosed.description: If true, includes businesses marked as permanently closed.

mode.title: ⚙️ Mode
mode.description: Fast mode extracts leads only. Deep mode enables website enrichment within the configured limits.

enrichWebsite.title: ✨ Enrich With Website Data
enrichWebsite.description: Visit business websites to extract emails, phones, contact forms, and social links. Used only in deep mode.

emailScanDepth.title: 📬 Email Scan Depth
emailScanDepth.description: Number of internal pages to scan for emails (e.g. /contact).

maxWebsitesToEnrich.title: 🌐 Max Websites To Enrich
maxWebsitesToEnrich.description: Maximum number of unique websites to visit in deep mode.

maxRunTimeSec.title: ⏱️ Max Run Time (sec)
maxRunTimeSec.description: Gracefully stop the run when this runtime budget is reached.

emailMxCheck.title: 🛡️ Verify Email Domains (MX)
emailMxCheck.description: If true, checks MX records for extracted email domains to improve email-quality confidence. Slower and adds DNS requests.

newOnlyOutput.title: 🆕 Output Only New Items
newOnlyOutput.description: If true, outputs only new items not seen in previous runs. If false, outputs unique items from this run and marks them with isNew.

webhookUrl.title: 🪝 Webhook URL
webhookUrl.description: URL to POST results to. Stored encrypted when saved (may contain auth tokens).

batchSize.title: 📬 Batch Size
batchSize.description: Number of items to batch before calling webhook.

resourceProfile.title: ⚙️ Resource Profile (memory)
resourceProfile.description: Preset for concurrency based on the memory you allocate when starting the run.

detailConcurrency.title: 🚄 Detail Concurrency
detailConcurrency.description: Place detail pages fetched in parallel. If not set, uses the value from Resource profile.

enrichmentConcurrency.title: ⚡ Enrichment Concurrency
enrichmentConcurrency.description: Website pages fetched in parallel during enrichment. If not set, uses the value from Resource profile.

debug.title: 🐞 Debug Mode
debug.description: Enable verbose logging (includes URLs and business details in logs; use only when needed).

proxyMode.title: Proxy Mode
proxyMode.description: Enable proxying. Google Maps uses Residential for browser compatibility and websites use Unblocker. Select Direct only for testing.

proxyCountryCode.title: Unblocker Country Code
proxyCountryCode.description: Optional two-letter country code, for example DE or US. Leave empty to let Unblocker choose.
